```artifact
Feature: Alarms System Testing

  Scenario: High Leakage Alarm
    Given the average leakage over X seconds is greater than 3 L/min
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the "high leakage" alarm should be active
    And the "high leakage" alarm should be high priority

  Scenario: Involuntary Shutdown Alarm
    Given the system detects an involuntary shutdown
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the "involuntary shutdown" alarm should be active
    And the "involuntary shutdown" alarm should be a continuous-tone alarm
    And the "involuntary shutdown" alarm should emit a sound tone for at least 2 minutes

  Scenario: Continuous-Tone Alarm Support
    Given the alarm subsystem supports continuous-tone alarms
    When the GUI computes a continuous-tone alarm
    Then the alarm should be a continuous-tone alarm

  Scenario: AC Mains Power Loss Alarm
    Given the GUI is connected to the "AC mains power loss" sensor
    And the AC mains power is lost
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the AC mains power loss alarm should be active
    And the AC mains power loss alarm should be medium priority

  Scenario Outline: High Leakage Alarm with Different Leakage Values
    Given the average leakage over X seconds is <leakage_value> L/min
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the "high leakage" alarm should be <alarm_status>
    And the "high leakage" alarm should be high priority

    Examples:
      | leakage_value | alarm_status |
      |---------------|--------------|
      | 2.5           | inactive     |
      | 3.5           | active       |
      | 4.0           | active       |

  Scenario Outline: Involuntary Shutdown Alarm with Different Detection States
    Given the system detects an involuntary shutdown is <shutdown_state>
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the "involuntary shutdown" alarm should be <alarm_status>
    And the "involuntary shutdown" alarm should be a continuous-tone alarm
    And the "involuntary shutdown" alarm should emit a sound tone for at least 2 minutes

    Examples:
      | shutdown_state | alarm_status |
      |----------------|--------------|
      | true           | active       |
      | false          | inactive     |

  Scenario Outline: AC Mains Power Loss Alarm with Different Power States
    Given the AC mains power is <power_state>
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the AC mains power loss alarm should be <alarm_status>
    And the AC mains power loss alarm should be medium priority

    Examples:
      | power_state | alarm_status |
      |-------------|--------------|
      | lost        | active       |
      | present     | inactive     |
```
